title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 — 2x DGX Spark vLLM (TP2 + MTP-3)
slug_note: Two GB10 boxes tensor-parallel over RoCE, 52-54 tok/s single-stream and up to 207 tok/s aggregate at 8 concurrent streams.

variation.quant_detail: NVIDIA ModelOpt NVFP4 export; FP8 KV cache

engine.config: vLLM TP2+EP+MTP3 across two DGX Spark nodes over ConnectX RoCE/IB, passwordless SSH, Docker on both (~126GiB free per node; rsync or NFS weight sharing). MAX_MODEL_LEN=262144, GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.835, fp8 KV default. start.sh auto-applies checkpoint fixes: PLE-table dtype re-injection, MTP layer-index alias, FP8_BLOCK_SCALES routed-experts patch (missing upstream — without it the MoE loads unquantized and dies ~7min in).

requirements.notes: ~62.7GB weights resident per node (64.3GiB with MTP), plus a 32GiB fp8 KV pool (~3.65M tokens). Requires two boxes on the same fabric.

steps.text: Provision two DGX Sparks on the same RoCE/IB fabric with passwordless SSH and Docker on both

measurements.context: batch-1 greedy, MTP OFF (README checkpoint table)
x8 aggregate (MAX_NUM_SEQS=8); 26.7 per-stream; aggregate scales 3.8x from x1
weights resident per node; fp8 KV pool 32.02 GiB = 3,652,200 tokens

caveats: The announcing tweet claims "~64 tok/s single stream, ~115 tok/s for 2-4 concurrent" and names SGLang+MTP, but the linked repo is vLLM and its server-read tables show 52.1-54.4 batch-1 / 86.5-128.1 at x2-x4. The numbers here come from the repo, per law 9; the tweet is discovery.
Requires two DGX Sparks on one fabric — a single Spark cannot run this lane.
The checkpoint needs three loader fixes applied by start.sh; a stock vLLM will fail or silently load the MoE unquantized.
MiaAI-Lab is the origin org this project measures against — credit, do not push upstream.
